title: Complications of chronic kidney disease
summary: Complications of chronic kidney disease (see 6.00C8) requiring at least three hospitalizations within a consecutive 12-month period and occurring at least 30 days apart. Each hospitalization must last at least 48 hours, including hours in a hospital emergency department immediately before the hospitalization.

children.criterion: Complications of chronic kidney disease (see 6.00C8) requiring at least three hospitalizations within a consecutive 12-month period and occurring at least 30 days apart. Each hospitalization must last at least 48 hours, including hours in a hospital emergency department immediately before the hospitalization. The hospitalizations may be for different complications of CKD (e.g., stroke, congestive heart failure, hypertensive crisis, acute kidney failure requiring a short course of hemodialysis).
